correctness.rationale: Explicit quotient dimension 16 and order-120 orthogonal action give complete coverage of all 65,535 nonzero cubic sections in 683 orbits. Chartwise exact characteristic-two Jacobian Gröbner unit ideals verify geometric smoothness in precisely 254 orbits of total size 27,060. For all 15 rational hyperplanes, square tests on smooth conics and F4 conjugate-line tests on tangent conics supply exact three-bit linear conditions for even geometric divisors. Orbit-size-weighted zero-syndrome counts give (5680,13580,7020,320,460); seven theta-count-four orbits weigh to 460. The included primary program was replayed from actual package files and a second program independently corroborated gradient nonvanishing over F2/F4/F8/F16 and reweighted profiles. Finite-extension testing alone is not a proof over the algebraic closure; the complete Groebner check is.

value.rationale: Theta-hyperplanes are a canonical geometric contact invariant; over F2 the split and nonsplit quadrics exhibit categorically different rational hyperplane-section geometry. The new exact five-bin arithmetic distribution on the complete nonsplit family, sharp four-plane cap, seven distinct equality orbits and mixed conic/tangent section profiles clarify the characteristic-two arithmetic boundary not supplied by general geometric counts. A natural finite complete classification is independently useful without requiring a broad new theorem.
